messages:
alex: Opening a small PR to split usage tiers into Metering + Pricing and clean up examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/980. Need quick review on SDK snippets and dashboard links.
maya: Link?
alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/980
jordan: Looked briefly: Python snippet still calls `client.create_metering`  update to `client.report_usage`. Also remove hardcoded grafana panel IDs.
samir: I'll update the snippet and add a deprecated legacy example with a clear banner for pinned SDKs.
ciara: Ops prefers tokens for panels, e.g. `{{dashboard:usage_overview}}`. Avoid public docs with internal IDs. Tag ops-infra if you need a redirect.
maya: Also clarify 429 behavior: show a sample response with `quota_reason` and `Retry-After` plus a tiny backoff snippet for docs-tests.
jordan: Adding backoff example:
```
for attempt in range(4):
  r = client.request(...)
  if r.status_code == 429:
    time.sleep(int(r.headers.get('Retry-After','1')) * (2**attempt))
  else:
    break
```
alex: I'll add the checklist to the PR description (snippet update, tokens, 429 example, doctest, i18n markers). Tests pass locally; queuing CI.
docs-bot: CI queued: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/980  lint will flag trailing spaces in fenced blocks.
samir: Fixed whitespace and pushed.
docs-bot: Staging preview ready: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/usage/metering  deprecated examples render, tokens resolved to friendly links.
ciara: Merged after a final rubber stamp. Release notes updated: "Split usage tiers; updated SDK examples; tokenized dashboard links; added migration checklist."
alex: Thanks all. Closing thread.
